reviewed_scope: All added product functions, imports and changed callers were read independently of their author.

Only the demonstrated module-level stdlib JSON/Path reader lambda may change the textual interpretation of rd NAME tokens. Original path/string data, other mutation patterns, command text and approval hash are preserved.

Only proved binding/direct-call token spans are masked. Unknown bindings, attributes, keywords, wildcard imports, capture, callback escape, visible rebinding and execution sinks retain the old conservative text.
Here-string recognition requires one complete single-quoted assignment and one complete recognized Python consumer; other statements or consumers do not acquire this interpretation.

The static Node writer grammar evaluates no JavaScript and admits no expressions, getters, templates or extra statements. Its exact literal destination passes through the existing write-target and preservation judge.
The existing canary, lock-switch and encoded-command checks precede the report profile. The profile cannot dispatch runtime requests; it describes only a constrained filesystem write.
Approval, backup, permanent retention, native adapter and existing mutation rules are not replaced. No generic zero-match, Python, script, MCP or arbitrary dynamic-code exemption is introduced.
resolved_before_execution: Initial broad NAME masking could include rd attributes and keyword tokens; replaced with proved token spans and conservative fallback.
Here-string variable spelling counts missed alternate or dynamic consumers; replaced with a whole-outside-program boundary.
A local function name alone did not establish a reader; limited to the explicit stdlib read expression with import/binding checks.
Imports preceding the lambda on the same source line were skipped; source ordering now compares line and column.

Framework review corrected baseline accounting to three methods/four failing assertions, pinned all three retained manifests, eliminated stale-cache ambiguity in its parent interpreter and enforced the stated CPython invocation.
remaining_gates: Commit/content identity, explicit authority for isolated public CI branch publication, then actual Windows/Linux qualification on the exact intended commit.
Independent raw CI job/results review, including deliberate baseline failures and every retained suite, before any deployment.
Verified reversible game-root publication and actual host controls are separate from CI or source acceptance.
limits: High confidence in the false-positive diagnosis; behavioral confidence in the unexecuted candidate is provisional. No passing or end-to-end result is claimed.
This bounded source classifier is not a hostile-code sandbox or complete Python/JavaScript effect analysis.
Complex original multi-statement Node reports and the exec-based diagnostic can remain unsupported. Their prior refused operations were not retried or repackaged.
The separate local test-run refusal is explained by fixture setup writes combined with inert protected-path strings. No local runner workaround has been used.
This review is not consumed as runtime authority, native acceptance or game-launch permission.
